verdicts.reason: A: the product circle is cut off at the top-left canvas edge and the can inside it is tiny. The NEW badge and Try It button sit between the headline and its subcopy, which breaks the reading order. Everything is packed into the top two-thirds, leaving the bottom third as dead orange space. B has a better left-to-right structure (headline, then copy, then CTA), but it breaks the product art. The cream circle is split off and left as a clipped blob in the bottom-left corner. The orange can now sits straight on the orange background, so it all but disappears; only its label band and the green dots stay visible. The NEW badge floats alone in the top-right corner, away from the product, and the headline is undersized for the canvas. A keeps the product graphic intact, so it is slightly less broken.
